platforms.notes: WRITE_VERIFIED — content-writer proof (login+edit+save+reread+post_match). Historical bumper authorized and restored; runtime NORMAL_BUMP with ~24h cooldown + persistent jitter. FUSED_UPDATE_BUMP active: content update only on real SAFE_DIFF, otherwise bump-only.

GH run 31950145270 (2026-08-16): real canary+rollback save on referee_reward, offer 113735 — canonical account+public match proven at every phase, personal_code/personal_link unchanged throughout, original value restored and confirmed. Auto only on real SAFE_DIFF.

WRITE_VERIFIED 2026-08-17 (GH run 32044775992, real canary+rollback on referee_reward): offre_sha256 changed on canary and restored exactly on rollback (byte-identical to before); public raw_html_sha256 same pattern; real POST captured to modification.php (status 302) with the correct payload at each phase; identity (company=Kraken, code_ou_lien=cpbrgddy) unchanged at all 4 checkpoints; no critical_fail; no unexpected_dialog; exactly 2 Save clicks. Promoted via manual reconciliation because the script's own account-side canonical_contains() check has a known truncation bug (compares a 200-char DOM preview against the full ~787-char rendered text -- see evidence.account_reread_note); the public-side check and every other independent signal confirm real success. Root cause of the PRIOR failed run (GH 31962858807) was an unhandled native confirm() dialog that Playwright dismissed by default -- fixed via the strict dialog gate + network instrumentation + guaranteed rollback + fresh pre-rollback identity re-guard added across commits 03e2715..8b5ccc3. Auto only on a real SAFE_DIFF.

PC_OFF_READY — headed WRITE_VERIFIED remains authoritative and GH headless save is PROVEN by run 32559662078: exactly two actual Save clicks, account plus full-public canary verification, exact source and normalized rollback, and public marker removal. Duplicate run 32559814742 was refused by the already-PROVEN gate before browser startup with zero Save clicks and zero platform writes. Auto only on a real SAFE_DIFF. No fake write.

GH 32265735051 (2026-08-19) VALIDATE ONLY, read-only, never clicked Commit: login OK, shop_id=4769 Kraken valid, draft_id=135, commit=false; Validate surfaced no existing-listing identifier. Official Agent Import docs describe bulk upload, while the official FAQ directs changes to the account Edit icon, limits a profile to one referral per shop/app, rejects duplicates, and warns repeated duplicate submissions may be flagged as spam. Therefore Agent Import is not a documented update path: NEVER_AUTO_COMMIT is durable without needing a speculative Commit. Keep native $200.

WRITE_VERIFIED headed canary eid=23004. SAVE_REQUIRES_CAPTCHA — content save stays HUMAN_SAVE_REQUIRED and Telegram must never auto-save. GitHub-hosted Chromium receives a Cloudflare Turnstile interstitial before login (read-only run 32565187359); no bypass. The scheduled bump is not disabled: it runs isolated in bump_referralcode_tv.yml (own concurrency group, own credentials, no CAPTCHA-solver key) as BUMP_ISOLATED_BEST_EFFORT — at most one #cliccami boost per run when login succeeds, and the challenge is classified EXPECTED_EXTERNAL_BLOCKER without retry, without bypass, and without failing the Code-Parrainage/Parrainage.co cycle.
No official OAuth / public write API (llms.txt account/admin/API not public). AUTH_BLOCKED_MANUAL durable. No bypass.
